proposal.coverage_limits: The source text contains conflicting party claims regarding the nature of the transfer (sub-letting vs. authorized distribution/agency/association). The lease deed clause permitting assignment to 'associate concerns' is cited by the Appellant but its admissibility and applicability are contested by the Respondent due to non-registration. The Court has not yet made a definitive finding on whether the specific arrangement with M/s. United Automobiles constitutes a 'sub-letting', 'assignment', or 'parting with possession' under Section 14(1)(b), nor has it determined if the lease clause provides valid written consent. The status of consent remains unknown as the text only presents the lease clause as a potential source of permission without confirming its legal effect or actual execution by the landlord for this specific transaction. The mode of transfer is also uncertain due to the competing characterizations.
